# Part I: Physical AI Foundations {.unnumbered}

Physical AI begins where computation ceases to be symbolic and becomes physical force. When an algorithm writes to a memory-mapped register on a pulse-width modulation timer, an H-bridge switches, current surges into motor windings, and mass accelerates under gravity and momentum. At that boundary, the forgiving conventions of digital software engineering—where errors can be caught by exceptions, retried in background loops, or patched post-crash—are superseded by the conservation laws of physics. Matter will not pause for an operating system scheduler, and inertia does not negotiate with neural network inference jitter.

This first part of the book constructs the physical and architectural container of the machine. It derives the physical, computational, and timing foundations that make embodied intelligence possible, establishing how to bridge stochastic machine learning models with deterministic physical dynamics.

### The Pillars of Part I
 
Following the foundational causal boundary established in Chapter 1, Part I progresses across three core chapters that construct the physical apparatus of the machine:

* **Chapter 2: The Body (*Physical Limits & Actuator Mechanics*):** Measures the five non-negotiable physical limits of the mechanical plant: sensor measurement age, stopping distance kinematics, actuator torque and slew saturation, thermal accumulation duty cycles ($I^2 R$), and electrical power delivery networks.
* **Chapter 3: The Brain (*Neural Computation & Memory Bandwidth Walls*):** Treats the neural model from a systems perspective, quantifying input/output contracts, inference memory traffic, the Roofline operational intensity model, and why large transformer/diffusion models operate at slow deliberative cadences.
* **Chapter 4: The Nervous System (*Multi-Rate Cadences & Deterministic Arbitration*):** Reconciles the unyielding Body with the stochastic Brain, deriving multi-rate execution cadences ($1000\text{ Hz}$, $10\text{--}100\text{ Hz}$, $1\text{--}5\text{ Hz}$) from physical time constants, implementing lock-free seqlock memory transport, and assembling the **5x5 Grid of Handoffs and Limits** that governs the entire text.

### What You Will Master in Part I

By the conclusion of Part I, you will possess a rigorous systems mental model of physical autonomy:

1. **The Closed Causal Loop:** Understanding how physical AI couples state transition dynamics ($s_{t+1} \sim P(s \mid s_t, a_t)$) with compute and communication latency.
2. **Deriving Rates from Physics:** Sizing control and inference frequencies directly from actuator electrical time constants ($\tau_e = L/R$), structural resonances, and photon integration windows.
3. **The 5x5 Synthesis Matrix:** Mapping every signal path in an embodied machine across five canonical handoffs (*Sensing $\to$ Perception $\to$ State $\to$ Plan $\to$ Enforce*) against five physical limits (*Latency, Bandwidth, Energy/Thermal, Determinism, Fault Domain*).
